svg.aria-label: Terminal: $ npm install vlm-code-context-mcp | # the code index: 6 tools, the default | $ npx code-context-reindex . --db ./context.db | $ claude mcp add code-context -- npx code-context ./context.db | # add-on: the sprint process (code-context-sprint) | $ npx code-context-mcp setup . | $ npx code-context-dashboard ./context.db # :3333
